patch.value: Enable native TypeScript contract checking when resolver identities are public

Follow-up to the compiler API redesign in PR 154. Stock TypeScript 7.0.2 exports an unstable native API with structured diagnostics but no resolveModuleName/packageId contract. Its installed dist/api/sync/api.d.ts and dist/api/proto.d.ts expose source metadata without resolved-module identity. The checker currently returns compiler_unavailable for API-incompatible compilers; the repository build pin is unchanged. Add native checking only through compiler-provided resolved package identities, preserving the current 5.9.3/6.0.3 API behavior and without stdout parsing, compiler substitution or package metadata ancestry.

Use a public native resolver identity API; clean and incompatible consumers pass direct diagnostic differential tests; retain the typed capability refusal until support exists; preserve all classic API and isolation regressions
